1.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
1.description: Harry discovers that he is the son of two well-known wizards and must attend Hogwarts.

2.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
2.description: A malevolent threat lurks at Hogwarts in Harry's second year.

3.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
3.description: Harry learns about Sirius Black and his supposed connection to Voldemort.

4.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
4.description: Harry is chosen for the dangerous Triwizard Tournament.

5.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
5.description: Harry trains students to defend against dark magic amid political turmoil.

6.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
6.description: Harry and Dumbledore search for the key to defeating Voldemort.

7.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
7.description: Harry, Ron and Hermione go on a mission to destroy Voldemort's Horcruxes.

8.title: Harry Potter and the Cursed Child
8.description: Harry’s son befriends Scorpius, and dark secrets emerge from the past.
